gen-gf-autour-one-gf-khula: Khula brings a deep midsection and curves that hold their mouths open, a sans body with room to breathe. And Autour One earns its keep when it's big and brief, its plain unshaded lines doing the shouting.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-liter: Autour One comes in loud, with a clear channel into every round letter. Liter, with no stroke contrast and lowercase of great vertical presence, settles in underneath and lets its wide-mouthed rounds do the quiet work.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-mada: Strokes of constant width, like bent pipe, give Autour One its bold, expressive voice. And Mada, with curves that refuse to close and a towering midzone, can be sized down a notch in body text.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-maven-pro: Expressive and bold up top, Autour One keeps its round letters smooth with no hairline-to-stem shift. But the real strength is the gap between them: Maven Pro stays modest and open-gapped while Autour One gets to be loud.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-michroma: Bent-straw lines, loud and expressive: Autour One has a bold look, while Michroma gives each letter a wide berth. Autour One earns its keep when it's big and short.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-mozilla-text: Every round letter in Autour One gets a clear channel leading in. That makes it best at announcing things, while Mozilla Text, with flared terminals and bold-looking lowercase, does the steady talking.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Smooth bold curves: Autour One has no swelling where curves meet stems, while Noto Sans Arabic gives small letters wide openings. Expressive up top, clean and modern below.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Armenian, whose c, s and z stand full and open. And in running text it reads smoothly, while Autour One keeps its constant pen-pressure look for headings.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Autour One looks ruler-drawn, every line a constant width, with a clear channel into each round letter. And Noto Sans Bengali, its capitals barely above lowercase height and its letter mouths distinctly open, is the quieter half.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Loud and smooth-joined: Autour One shows no contrast between stems and joins. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki comes in beneath it with coiled-rope lowercase and readable open apertures, so the two sit together without crowding.
